articles.title: Kalshi, Polymarket asked to testify on deceptive marketing
articles.summary: The CFTC is apparently tired of watching prediction market platforms skate by with minimal regulatory friction, so they've summoned Kalshi and Polymarket to explain why their marketing doesn't match what the law actually allows them to do. If regulators start getting aggressive about what these platforms can claim, expect stricter guardrails on how prediction markets operate, who can trade on them, and possibly what events they're allowed to host.

articles.title: What is Betr, the Jake Paul app Tony Romo joined? Is it legal, and is it gambling?
articles.summary: Betr is a sports betting app that's somehow convinced both Jake Paul and Tony Romo to lend their names to what appears to be a legal gray area between gambling and fantasy sports. The regulatory ambiguity matters because if regulators crack down, it could reshape how the entire prediction markets ecosystem operates around celebrity-endorsed platforms.

articles.title: Polymarket code “SILIVE” enhances $25 referral promo for Thanksgiving night football
articles.summary: Polymarket is running a Thanksgiving night football promo with a $25 referral bonus, sweetened by the code "SILIVE" that apparently boosts the deal. The timing coincides with peak sports betting season, so they're clearly gunning to poach liquidity from competitors right when casual bettors are most likely to sign up.

articles.title: Experts release early Oregon vs. Washington predictions, best bets for Saturday’s rivalry game
articles.summary: The Oregon Ducks and Washington Huskies face off Saturday with early expert picks and wagering recommendations already circulating ahead of the rivalry matchup. This game matters because sharp bettors move prediction markets fast, and early expert consensus often signals where the smart money's already flowing.

articles.title: Opinion | Kalshi’s sports bets are everywhere. They’re also likely illegal.
articles.summary: Kalshi, the prediction markets platform, is getting slapped with legal pushback over sports betting offerings that regulators say violate federal law. If the feds actually enforce this, it could crater the entire regulatory gray zone that lets prediction markets operate in the US.

articles.title: 5 Stocks Poised to Benefit as Prediction Markets Gain Traction
articles.summary: Prediction markets are finally going mainstream, and a handful of publicly traded companies are positioned to capture the upside as betting volumes explode. If these stocks actually move, it's the first real signal that the market is pricing in a genuine shift in how Americans will gamble and speculate over the next decade.

articles.title: Is Tickmill Launching Prediction Markets?
articles.summary: Tickmill, a retail forex and CFD broker, is apparently considering entry into the prediction markets space. If they launch, they're bringing an established brokerage infrastructure and retail customer base into a market that's been fragmented between crypto platforms and traditional betting sites.

articles.title: Federal judge orders Kalshi to block sports betting on tribal lands
articles.summary: A federal judge has ordered Kalshi, the prediction markets platform, to stop offering bets on sporting events occurring on tribal lands. The ruling creates a messy jurisdictional headache for anyone trying to build a scalable prediction market in the US, since tribal sovereignty arguments could now torpedo bets on any event remotely connected to Native American territories.

articles.title: Young New Yorkers are losing money on prediction markets. That's not a reason to ban them.
articles.summary: Young New Yorkers are hemorrhaging cash on prediction markets, sparking the usual calls for regulatory crackdowns that miss the actual point. The real story is whether markets survive their awkward teenage years or if regulators kill them before they prove their value.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: Danny McBride is the insufferable Thanksgiving uncle in Kalshi’s new ad
articles.summary: Kalshi tapped Danny McBride to play the archetypal annoying uncle in a new ad, presumably to humanize their prediction markets platform through relatable holiday chaos. The move signals Kalshi is spending serious money on mainstream brand awareness as they race to capture bettors before rivals like Polymarket gain total market dominance.

articles.title: Prediction markets, betting odds weigh in on whether LSU will actually leave the SEC
articles.summary: LSU's future conference affiliation has become unstable enough that prediction markets are actively pricing the odds of the Tigers bolting the SEC. If a school as entrenched as LSU actually leaves, it signals the entire power conference structure is in free fall and bets on other program moves suddenly look a lot cheaper.
